name: io.github.red-panda-gamedev/redpand-mcp
description: RedPand MCP server: lets AI agents drive the Unity Editor through the RedPand MCP plugin.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Plugin -> Server connection timeout (ms) (default: 10000). Tool calls use MCP_PLUGIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT instead.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: How long one tool call may run in the plugin (ms). A tool call is sent once and never re-sent (default: 300000, or MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TIMEOUT if larger)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PLUGIN_CLIENT_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Client -> Server transport type: stdio or streamableHttp (default: stdio)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: none (default) or token. token gates the plugin connection and the HTTP endpoint on MCP_PLUGIN_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: This server's public URL; its origin is allowed for browser clients.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BIND
environmentVariables.description: Network bind address: loopback (default), any (0.0.0.0), or a specific IP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma/semicolon-separated additional allowed Origins for browser clients (in addition to loopback + the MCP_PUBLIC_URL origin). Avoids a blanket wildcard on credentialed paths.
